nodes.text: Your straps are holding. Good. Ready for the bigger cousins? Worgs are running with the packs northwest — a worg fang goes through cheap leather like wet paper, and I want four for buckle-work.
You won't. They find you — that's the song. You'll hear it start behind you and finish in front. Keep your back to a rock and swing at the second howl, not the first.
Thin the runners, take four good fangs. There's a snare kit in it — my own build, not the market's.
Fair. The song's not going anywhere. Neither are the teeth.
